rule_reason: identity: no cost and no separation, so it keeps
interpretation: The relationship keeps its shape, but only one of its three terms has even a partial partner. The Idle is in proportion to an enclosed [charge], which the table does not name. 'Closed surface' and 'enclosed' are spatial separations of inside from outside, which the mirror forbids, and the table offers no replacement.
closing: The rule decided on its own: an identity keeps. There was nothing to weigh. But the statement is built on inside-versus-outside of a closed surface, and both of those words are banned on the nonphysical side with no frozen substitute, so what keeps its shape is a shape with no content. Charge again has no partner. (Amendment 1 applied: shape is the rule's call on the relationship; unmapped terms are listed separately and described in plain words in the sentence.)
